rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial word for the edible potato tuber.

example.english: I bought two potato tubers and brought them home.
example.traditional: 我買咗兩個薯仔返屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 loeng5 go3 syu4 zai2 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this formal or written alternative when referring to the edible potato tuber.

example.english: The recipe recommends peeling the potato first.
example.traditional: 食譜建議先將馬鈴薯去皮。
example.jyutping: sik6 pou2 gin3 ji5 sin1 zoeng1 maa5 ling4 syu4 heoi3 pei4
